headline: Stalexport Autostrada Małopolska Cuts Most Staff as Polish A4 Toll Concession Ends
summary: Stalexport Autostrada Małopolska announced group layoffs covering almost its entire staff except the management board, following the expiration of its toll road concession on Poland's A4 highway.
why: The A4 section between Katowice and Krakow is one of Poland's highest-volume commercial freight routes, transitioning back to state administration.

impacts.name: Stalexport Autostrady
impacts.why: Losing the highway concession eliminates the company's primary toll collection revenue stream.
